title: NotSoHungarian
description: Client-side chat tweaks that fixes "ez" on Hypixel.
body:
# NotSoHungarian - small chat fix for Hypixel

Hypixel can replace your whole message with a silly phrase if it detects `ez` in it.  
This mod prevents that by swapping the `e` in `ez` to the Cyrillic lookalike. To players it looks the same, but it avoids the trigger so your sentence stays intact.


## Why does it exist?
In Hungarian, **"ez" means "this"**, so Hungarian players naturally use it in normal sentences and the filter can accidentally nuke perfectly harmless messages.


## How it works:
- Only targets the standalone word `ez` - no other words are affected
- Only changes the `e` in that word: `ez` → `еz` (Cyrillic `e`)
- Only modifies your own outgoing message (never incoming chat, never other players)

- Works if `ez` appears multiple times in the same message
- Works with both lowercase and uppercase forms (case-insensitive)
- Works with normal chat and command messages too (e.g. `/r`, `/msg`, etc.)

- Applied automatically after you send the message - no toggle, no settings
- Lightweight: does nothing unless your message contains the standalone word `ez`
